setup:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
n = 5000
k = rng.integers(0, 4, n)
centers = rng.normal(0, 8, (4, 20))
df = pd.DataFrame(centers[k] + rng.normal(0, 1, (n, 20)), columns=[f'x{i}' for i in range(20)])
df['cluster'] = [f'grp_{v}' for v in k]

steps.name: switch to 3D and wait for layout
steps.report: { dims: a.dims, nAnchors: a.prepared.nAnchors, nKept: a.nKept, anchorLen: a.anchorXY.length }

steps.name: wait for hit index to be built after camera settles
steps.report: { nScreenPts: a._3dScreenXY ? a._3dScreenXY.length / 2 : 0, hitReady: a.hit !== null }

steps.name: points are drawn (non-black pixels appear in 3D)
steps.eval: const url = a.renderer.toDataURL('#000000'); const img = new Image(); await new Promise(r => { img.onload = r; img.src = url; }); const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = img.width; c.height = img.height; c.getContext('2d').drawImage(img, 0, 0); const d = c.getContext('2d').getImageData(0, 0, c.width, c.height).data; let n = 0; for (let k = 0; k < d.length; k += 4) if (d[k] + d[k+1] + d[k+2] > 60) n++; window.__pixels3d = n

steps.name: legend: hiding a category reduces rendered point count in 3D
hover at anchor 0 screen position shows tooltip
steps.eval: const sx = a._3dScreenXY[0], sy = a._3dScreenXY[1]; a.onPointer({ x: sx, y: sy, world: [0, 0] })
steps.report: { tooltipRow: a.tooltip ? a.tooltip.row : null, screenPos: a._3dScreenXY ? [a._3dScreenXY[0].toFixed(1), a._3dScreenXY[1].toFixed(1)] : null }

steps.name: capture orbit angle, then drag to rotate camera
steps.drag: (() => { const r = document.querySelector('.plot').getBoundingClientRect(); const cx = r.left + r.width / 2; const cy = r.top + r.height / 2; return [[cx, cy], [cx + 150, cy], [cx + 150, cy - 60]]; })()
steps.until: a.hit !== null && a._3dScreenXY !== null && window.__orbitBefore !== undefined && ((a.renderer.deck.getViewState && a.renderer.deck.getViewState() ? a.renderer.deck.getViewState().rotationOrbit : 1) !== window.__orbitBefore)

steps.name: lasso selects points in 3D using screen-space positions
steps.drag: (() => { const xy = a._3dScreenXY; if (!xy) return []; const r = document.querySelector('.plot').getBoundingClientRect(); const cv = a.colorValues; const target = 0; const pts = []; for (let i = 0; i < a.nKept; i++) { if (cv && cv[i] === target) pts.push([xy[2*i], xy[2*i+1]]); } if (pts.length < 3) { for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(100, a.nKept); i++) pts.push([xy[2*i], xy[2*i+1]]); } const med = k => pts.map(p => p[k]).sort((u,v)=>u-v)[pts.length>>1]; const cx = med(0), cy = med(1); const d = pts.map(p => Math.hypot(p[0]-cx, p[1]-cy)); const dm = [...d].sort((u,v)=>u-v)[d.length>>1]; const near = pts.filter((_,i) => d[i] < 2 * dm).sort((p,q) => p[0]-q[0] || p[1]-q[1]); const cross = (o,p,q) => (p[0]-o[0])*(q[1]-o[1])-(p[1]-o[1])*(q[0]-o[0]); const lo = [], hi = []; for (const p of near) { while (lo.length>=2 && cross(lo[lo.length-2],lo[lo.length-1],p)<=0) lo.pop(); lo.push(p); } for (const p of [...near].reverse()) { while (hi.length>=2 && cross(hi[hi.length-2],hi[hi.length-1],p)<=0) hi.pop(); hi.push(p); } const hull = lo.slice(0,-1).concat(hi.slice(0,-1)); return hull.map(([x,y]) => { const k = Math.hypot(x-cx,y-cy)||1; return [r.left+x+8*(x-cx)/k, r.top+y+8*(y-cy)/k]; }); })()
